text: Article · research post · Epoch AI · updated 23 September 2026 The plunging price of thought Luke Emberson, David Roodman (Epoch AI) · published 22 September 2026 In one line: On five benchmarks (AIME, FrontierMath tiers 1-3, GPQA Diamond, chess and a secret game's puzzles), from 2023 to mid-2026, the cheapest per-question cost of reaching a fixed score (tokens used times archived list prices, lower budgets simulated by truncating runs) fell about 47% a quarter, 13x a year, averaged over a lattice of dates and scores; 43% to 53% by benchmark, with no uncertainty reported by design.
label: core
key: article · research post · epoch ai ·
